kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نرثعن (form IVq)
# نَرْثَعِنُّ (narṯaʕinnu) /nar.θa.ʕin.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْثَعَنَّ (irṯaʕanna)
# نَرْثَعِنَّ (narṯaʕinna) /nar.θa.ʕin.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْثَعَنَّ (irṯaʕanna)
# نَرْثَعِنِّ (narṯaʕinni) /nar.θa.ʕin.ni/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْثَعَنَّ (irṯaʕanna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
